decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line PR title from the release notes [ev-0bdd4090fd7b]. It says that GCP "workload identity parameters" are now optional, but it does not name the fields, their CRD kind or schema paths, or what was required before. It is listed under BREAKING CHANGES but says nothing about what breaks. Without the named fields, neither the subject nor an exposure condition can be written. The PR diff or the changed CRD schema for the GCP provider's workloadIdentity auth block is needed.
